title: Batch Convert HEIC Photos to JPEG on iPhone
description: Convert several HEIC photos to JPEG in one batch on iPhone. Match the saved copies to the originals and check file format and capture dates.
direct: Convert several photos together and confirm that each selected original has a matching JPEG copy.
figureAlt: Editorial still life of three distinct photo prints, showing a lighthouse, a yellow bicycle and market fruit, laid beside an open file envelope
cards.decision.heading: Test a few files first
cards.decision.body: Start with two or three photos that you can easily tell apart. Include one with fine detail. Save the test copies together so you can compare them with the original selection.
sections.detail-1.heading: Check dates in the saved copies
sections.detail-1.body: Preserve the capture date if the receiving library needs it. A file browser can instead sort by the time of export. Open one saved example in the destination to see how that library sorts it.
sections.detail-2.heading: About the app
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone app. Check the App Store listing for current access and export options.
faqs.first-question.heading: Do two photos use one conversion?
faqs.first-question.body: Each successful photo uses a conversion. The current listing includes three successful conversions before an unlimited plan is needed.
faqs.second-question.heading: Could the JPEGs be bigger?
faqs.second-question.body: Yes. Check saved sizes before using this workflow to meet an attachment limit.

steps.step-1.text: Select the HEIC photos in PhotoFix and choose JPEG output. Review the options for the capture date and location.
steps.step-2.text: Check file details to confirm JPEG. Match the number and subject of the exported files to the originals.
steps.step-3.text: Send the checked JPEG copies and keep the HEIC files for future exports.
